decisions.reason: The ALCMS distributed control unit extends the firm's core airfield lighting business, and its visibility grew from a mention to its own page, so it likely meets aspirations in an industry with growing turnover.

The air situation display complements the tower and surveillance portfolio and gained its own page; with no evidence of a shortfall and enough slack from a growing, hiring firm, there is no trigger for problemistic search.
Training services are a low-cost, recurring-revenue part of the integrated service offer, so carrying them puts little strain on resources.

The airfield ground lighting course ties directly to the core lighting installed base, though its lower web visibility makes it a somewhat more likely candidate for consolidation into broader training.
The collaboration software fits the strategic move toward collaborative decision-making and real-time information sharing, which justifies continued support even while results are still uncertain.
As the flagship multilateration surveillance product aligned with the firm's direction, it gets strategic commitment and slack-backed patience despite long airport procurement cycles.
